notes.title: Drive 21 v0.4 Update
notes.notes:
[h3]Hello Everyone![/h3]

[h3]Drive 21 v0.4 Update[/h3]

[h3][Fixes and Content][/h3]
- Taxi System added.
- Keyboard + Mouse Vehicle Driving Support.
- New Traffic Vehicles Added.
- Vehicles In Traffic In Certain Places Have Been Speed Increased.
- Added Real Time Reflection.

[h2]Taxi System[/h2]

[h3]Go To The Taxi Icon On The Map.[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38709255/3cf1ecc44e02567bc60de618a481e859894aa3d9.jpg[/img]

[h3]Activate the Closed Text at the Taxi Stop. (When your taxi is open, your own vehicle is closed.)[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38709255/d092e94bdac58b0713d458dca44c72fb7b6da67b.jpg[/img]

[h3]Get in Taxi.[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38709255/b5ac6ecead64c6bf918794d9ad6b3c3b5a828019.jpg[/img]

[h3]You can turn the taxi mission on and off with Press END Button.[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38709255/74b4024dbe2961a6ca1b03f045e8296a3205b5ad.gif[/img]

[h3]Accept or reject the mission over the radio.[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38709255/d13416312fad1afb1bec3e981886a54bec11df3a.jpg[/img]

[h3]Passengers are waiting for you at any location on the map.[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38709255/b7718324ffd363c788befc3057597bd9ed0901e1.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38709255/77fde0ba5d0b1bb301c8e6824b896b9de6ee28d1.jpg[/img]

[h3]1- Taximeter (Money You Will Earn in Distance Traveled.)
2- Time.
3- Your Destination.[/h3]
